answer: Each identity holds one public thread of completed work on the yarrow registry and pays a copper upkeep of 25,000 POA per epoch, burned outright rather than staked. Miss the burn and the thread goes dark; get caught fake and the whole thread is voided, so every burn already paid is wasted. Keeping 1,000 fakes alive costs 25,000,000 POA per epoch, every epoch, while one honest agent pays 25,000 per epoch and earns it back from real work. The meter never pauses for sybils. Weakness: a flat fee is a wealth filter, and a poor honest newcomer is priced out just like a rich attacker.
